title: Excess Mileage Rate Reduction for Current Kestrel Balloon and Retail Customers — Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease
content:
# Rate Card Note — Per-Mile Rate Reduction, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Closed-End Units

**Rule.** For the excess mileage charge on a closed-end commercial unit of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease whose lease ended by a turn-in or by a recovery after an uncured default, the class rate is reduced by the mileage rate reduction: $0.05 a mile where the business holds an active Kestrel Advantage Balloon contract with no days past due and an active Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract with no days past due, $0.03 a mile where it holds an active balloon contract with no days past due but no active Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract with no days past due, and nothing where it holds no active balloon contract with no days past due.

**Which contracts.** A Kestrel Advantage Balloon contract is a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract. For it and for the Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract, what is read is whether the business holds one whose status is active and whose days past due are zero.

## Reduction table

| Active Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract with zero days past due | Active Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract with zero days past due | Reduction per mile |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | $0.05 |
| Yes | No | $0.03 |
| No | Yes | nothing |
| No | No | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical)

1. The business holds an active balloon contract 0 days past due and an active retail installment contract 12 days past due: the retail contract does not have zero days past due, so the reduction is $0.03 a mile.
2. The business holds an active balloon contract 5 days past due and an active retail installment contract 0 days past due: no balloon contract with zero days past due, so nothing.
3. Both contracts active and current: $0.05 a mile; a $0.25 rate becomes $0.20 a mile.
